description: SYNTHETIC — not market data: seeded minute+daily bars and 5s top-of-book quotes

quotes.method: vectorized invariants (positive, uncrossed, unlocked, increasing, inside regular session); interval 5s

limitations: Seeded geometric random walk; price levels, spreads, sizes and volumes are modelled, not observed
Regular session only on real XNYS trading days (holidays/early closes from exchange_calendars)
No corporate actions, halts, auctions, news or market impact are modelled
